decisionsTitle: The members' zone in three tabs: «Coduri de reducere», «Magazin», «Alergări»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11:** «zona de membri are nevoie de tab-uri: coduri de reducere, magazin, alergări». The zone (§524) drew everything on one long page, and a member looking for the shop scrolled past the codes and the runs.

**Decision.** Three tabs, in the owner's order, each an address of its own: `/members-area/codes` («Coduri de reducere», `/zona-membri/coduri`), `/members-area/shop` («Magazin», `/zona-membri/magazin`) and `/members-area` itself («Alergări»: the club's words for members, the members' events, the next runs). Links, not a tab widget, the house's secondary-tab row (`SubNav`, §360): real navigation, the panel rendered on the server, no client island, the entries 44 px tall and a row that scrolls rather than wraps on a phone (§79's reason against MUI's scroll arrows). The frame (title, greeting, tabs, sign-out) is `members-area/zone.tsx`; the door is not: `openZone` is called by each of the three pages, because a layout is not re-run when a member moves between tabs, so the sign-in redirect, the 404 for an account that may not open the zone and the database-away page are asserted on every tab (BR-REQ-060-01). All three paths sit under the private segment already (`private-paths.ts`: `no-store`, `noindex`, `robots.txt`).

**Where the old links land.** «Alergări» keeps the zone's own address, so the sign-in's landing (`landingFor`), the members' page button and the backoffice layout's redirect still arrive at a part that always has something on it, rather than at an empty first tab. The shop's two verbs answer back to `/members-area/shop` with `?shop=` and `?shopAt=` (§683), and the order emails' button opens the same tab (`#members-shop`). The words «Coduri de reducere» and «Magazin» each have an empty-state sentence now, since the tab is always there.

**Refused.** Hiding an empty tab (the tabs would then change under a member from one visit to the next; the owner asked for three). A client-side tab widget or MUI `Tabs` (scroll arrows on a phone, a panel the server cannot render per address). Making «Coduri de reducere» the zone's own address (the first tab, as the owner listed them, but the members' events, with the register button, are what a member comes for, and the codes may be none).
changelogLine: - **The members' zone in three tabs** — «Coduri de reducere», «Magazin» and «Alergări», each its own address under the zone, the shop's answers and order emails landing on «Magazin». §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: The members' zone shows three tabs in this order, «Coduri de reducere», «Magazin», «Alergări», as links 44 px tall, each page at its own address (`/zona-membri/coduri`, `/zona-membri/magazin`, `/zona-membri`), the current one marked `aria-current`, and only the current part drawn: the codes and the shop are not on the runs' page and the runs are not on theirs (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Each of the members' zone's three tab pages asserts the door itself: signed out it redirects to the sign-in in the members' words, an account that may not open the zone gets a 404 and no tab shows a way into the backoffice (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
